subject: general
question: Which of the following Indian slums is one of the world's largest slums?
solution:
The correct answer is __Dharavi__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Dharavi is a locality in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India, considered to be one of Asia's largest slums. 
 
• Dharavi has an area of just over 2.1 square kilometres and a population of about 1,000,000.
 
• With a population density of over 277,136/km2, Dharavi is one of the most densely populated areas in the world.
 
• The Dharavi slum was founded in 1884 during the British colonial era.
 
• It grew because of the expulsion of factories and residents from the peninsular city centre by the colonial government and from the migration of rural Indians into urban Mumbai.
 
• For this reason, Dharavi is currently a highly diverse settlement religiously and ethnically.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Dharavi has an active informal economy in which numerous household enterprises employ many of the slum residents as leather, textiles, and pottery products are among the goods made inside Dharavi.
 
• Dharavi has suffered from many epidemics and other disasters, including a widespread plague in 1896 which killed over half of the population of Mumbai. 
 
• Sanitation in the slums remains poor.
